description: Every file under the scanned test roots belongs to exactly one suite or one helper entry. Run `npm run test:suites -- --check` after adding a test; docs/testing/TEST-SUITES.md explains each suite.

python3.hint: Install Python 3.11+ or set PYTHON to an interpreter.

python-playwright.hint: Create a scratch venv, pip install playwright==1.57.0, run `python -m playwright install chromium`, then set PYTHON to that venv interpreter (see companion-concept-verification.yml).

chromium.hint: Provision Chromium explicitly: `node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js install chromium` (optionally with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH in a scratch directory) or set SHELL_CHROMIUM.

build.hint: Run `npm run build` first; the analyzer-archive gate copies the built dist/ assets.

qualified-npm.hint: Set QUALIFIED_NPM to the npm 11.19.1 CLI script (npm-cli.js); no global installation is used.

native-runner.hint: Provision the isolated native runner: npm install --prefix .native-runner --save-exact obsidian-launcher@3.2.1 (see TEST-SUITES.md).

concept-chromium.hint: Set CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE to the Chromium binary the Python Playwright install provides (default /usr/bin/chromium).

suites.name: runtime
suites.purpose: Plugin runtime: domain, application services, adapters, Vue/Pinia presentation and the in-memory Obsidian test kit.
suites.verifyStep: production coverage run (vitest.production.config.mjs) executes every runtime test

suites.name: cli
suites.purpose: Central shell.mjs CLI: command parsing, plans, process execution, kit/archive distribution, new-project creation and capability discovery.

suites.name: cli:journey
suites.purpose: Packs the framework ZIP, extracts it and builds independent generated consumers with a qualified npm (slow, writes reports/framework-cli).

suites.name: generator
suites.purpose: Project compiler: companion JSON to generated project files, runtime guards, starters and the shared safe file-plan engine.

suites.name: companion
suites.purpose: Companion concept contracts: project JSON, storymaps, details, composition, concept isolation zone and concept metrics.

suites.name: companion:assembly
suites.purpose: Offline companion assembly check, Python assembly/tamper test and syntax check of every authored concept module.

suites.name: companion:browser
suites.purpose: Aggregated companion concept browser suites on one exact assembled artifact (Python Playwright + Chromium).

suites.name: companion:browser-manual
suites.purpose: Historical concept browser scripts that the aggregated runner does not execute; run individually per docs/concepts/companion/VERIFICATION.md.

suites.name: test-data
suites.purpose: Companion test-data kit: seeded generators, storage plans, loopback server/client and source inventory.

suites.name: makers
suites.purpose: Authoring tools: maker recipes and catalog, event contracts, generated-code formatting, example removal and README ownership.

suites.name: native
suites.purpose: Native host protocol and dev-loop tooling units (isolation, identity, receipts, diagnostics, performance reports) without launching Obsidian.

suites.name: native:host
suites.purpose: Real Obsidian smoke in an isolated scratch vault (downloads the host; never a personal vault).

suites.name: setup
suites.purpose: Guided setup identity, npm install policy, staged build/local install, CSS identity scoping and harness preview.

suites.name: release
suites.purpose: Release preparation, promotion plans, remote execution, audit classification, maintenance discovery and qualification triggers.

suites.name: quality
suites.purpose: Repository gates: analyzer, lint, coverage inventory, maintainability, presentation, repository and test-quality policies, evidence producers and this suite manifest.

suites.name: baseline
suites.purpose: Dependency-free verification baseline: fault ledger, policy, runner, report, source, token and HTTP style-specimen checks, repeated three times.

suites.name: browser-specimen
suites.purpose: Host-style specimen assertions in a real browser (served mode).

suites.name: e2e
suites.purpose: Served harness in Chromium via Playwright: showcase, modals, persistence lifecycle, accessibility and design system.

suites.name: project
suites.purpose: Generated product tests (tests/project) that exist only in a project created by the companion compiler.

suites.name: project:ui-effects
suites.purpose: Generated composition/UI-effect checks of a companion-generated project.

suites.name: obsidian
suites.purpose: Vitest-driven end-to-end tests against a real sandboxed Obsidian host.

aliases.tooling: Every suite that verify runs in its serialized node --test tooling step.

helpers.purpose: Synthetic vault copied for each real-Obsidian case
Runtime fixtures, helpers and shared types
Real-host test support, fixtures and declarations
